title: Introduce Capacity Hedge Broker and Proportional Backfill Prioritizer
author: Lina Park
description: Add a new Capacity Hedge Broker that centralizes decisions about how committed (reserved) capacity and opportunistic spare capacity are distributed across tenants. This broker enables proportional backfilling of idle slots while preserving per-tenant throughput guarantees and a bounded latency safety budget. Motivation: we've seen bursty tenancy cause long-tail latencies when opportunistic backfill aggressively preempts low-priority reservations. The broker implements (1) an occupancy partition model to split pool capacity into guaranteed, hedge, and opportunistic partitions, (2) proportional backfill logic that apportions opportunistic capacity by committed share plus recent utilization footprint, and (3) a soft-demotion penalty/decay so repeated preemption of a tenant reduces its opportunistic weight temporarily. This change touches the allocator, autoscaler decision path, and telemetry plumbing. It also adds unit and integration tests for backfill fairness and a small migration that initializes per-tenant hedge credits for existing reservations. The description below summarizes commits, files changed, review conversation, CI status, and merge details.

ci_summary: Initial CI: build failed on lint (long functions) -> fixed; unit tests initially had two flaky tests in allocator that were stabilized; integration tests pass in CI matrix. E2E staging run passed on 2026-01-31 (compat with existing reservation workflow verified).
release_notes: Introduce Capacity Hedge Broker (feature-flagged) to enable proportional backfilling and improved fairness; adds telemetry metrics for occupancy partition and backfill fairness. No customer-facing API changes. Rollout gating required: enable feature flag and run migration to seed hedge credits.
migration_instructions: Run migrations/20260201_seed_hedge_credits.sql against control plane DB during maintenance window; enable feature-flag 'capacity_hedge_broker' in a canary region; monitor backfill_fairness_index and per-tenant latency percentile metrics before full roll-out.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge behind feature flag. 2) Run migration to seed hedge credits. 3) Canary-enable in us-west-2 for 48 hours. 4) Promote to remaining regions with automated health checks. 5) If fairness index regresses by >5% or 99th latency increases >10ms, rollback feature flag.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: premature preemption could impact tail latency for critical tenants. Mitigation: broker enforces a locked latency safety budget per-tenant and uses a decay period for demotion weights; rollback via feature flag and migration can be reversed (credits are additive).
performance_notes: Benchmarks in lab show median throughput unchanged, opportunistic utilization increased by ~8% on low-util clusters, and 99th-percentile latency improved for best-effort tenants due to fewer repeated preemptions. See test matrix reference in PR comments.
comments: Diego Rivera (reviewer): Nice separation of concerns. Two asks: 1) can we simplify the occupancy partition constants as configurable knobs in config.yaml instead of hardcoded values? 2) please add a test simulating rapid repeated preemptions to validate the decay behavior.

Lina Park (author): Responding - moved partition constants to config and added decay_simulation_test in tests/integration. The test includes a ramped preemption pattern and asserts demotion weight never drops below configured floor.
Maya Chen (reviewer): Telemetry looks good but please add per-tenant tags to hedge_credit_gauge to allow filtering by organization. Also request an alert on unexpected negative hedge_credit deltas.
Lina Park (author): Added tenant_id tag to hedge_credit_gauge and a simple alert rule in ops/alerts.yaml recommending threshold-based alerting on negative deltas exceeding 5% of total credits.
Owen Blake (approver): Approving after the above fixes. Verified stage run and canary results. :thumbsup:
CI Bot: All checks green. Integration matrix completed on linux/amd64 and linux/arm64. e2e staging run green.
discussion_summary: Reviewers requested config-driven partitions, additional fairness tests, and telemetry tagging; author addressed all points. Performance signals in staging were positive. The PR was approved and merged via squash.
merge_commit_message: squash: introduce capacity hedge broker and proportional backfill; add telemetry and migration
post_merge_actions: 1) apply migration in control plane during next maintenance window; 2) enable feature flag in canary; 3) run smoke pipeline that validates per-tenant SLOs and backfill_fairness_index; 4) schedule follow-up to add CLI tooling for hedge credit inspection
notes_for_sre: SRE should monitor metrics: telemetry.occupancy_partition.{guaranteed,hedge,opportunistic}, telemetry.backfill_fairness_index, telemetry.hedge_credit_gauge (per-tenant), allocator.preempt_events, and per-tenant p95/p99 latency. Default decay window is 10 minutes and can be tuned via config. If rollout shows increased eviction churn, flip feature flag off and notify infra oncall.
